name: Sparkline list
oneLiner: a glass watchlist panel stands up with a pulsing live tag; each row has a name, a value that ticks and a live sparkline that scrolls left as new points arrive, with a change chip; one row bends up hard, lifts out of the list and flips green, line, glow and chip
say: when the speaker compares a few channels or products and one is taking off ('everything else was flat, but the long videos went up 61 percent'): cut in on the list, the row lifts green on the word that names the winner
